map.泊松分布概率计算器 使用指南: Poisson Distribution Probability Calculator User Guide
map.输入单位时间（或空间）内事件的平均发生率 λ 和目标发生次数 k，计算泊松分布的: Enter the mean occurrence rate lambda per unit time (or space) and the target count k to compute the Poisson probability mass function P(X=k), that is the probability of exactly k events, widely used to model rare events such as customer calls and fault counts.
map.单位时间/空间事件数：P(X=k)=λ^k·e^−λ/k!。: Events per unit time and space: P(X=k) = lambda^k * e^-lambda / k!.
map.λ 为平均发生率（均值=方差）。: lambda is the mean occurrence rate (mean = variance).
map.：P(X=0)=e^−3≈0.0498，约 5% 概率无人到达。: P(X=0) = e^-3 = about 0.0498, so about a 5% chance nobody arrives.
map.由两组样本量方差求合并方差: Pooled Variance from Two Sample Variances
map.由事件概率求其补事件概率: Complement event probability from an event probability
map.泊松何时近似二项？: When Does the Poisson Approximate the Binomial?
map.n 大、p 小、np=λ 适中时，二项≈泊松，常用于稀有事件建模。: With large n, small p and moderate np = lambda, the binomial approximates the Poisson, which is widely used to model rare events.
map.能，λ 是平均率（如每小时 2.5 次），不要求整数。: Yes, lambda is an average rate (such as 2.5 per hour) and need not be an integer.
